tasks.title: Versioned Mapping Master + unmapped-GL bucket
tasks.objective: Build the versioned repo-owned Mapping Master as the single runtime authority for selection and validation, with the unmapped-GL bucket keeping the DUB slice complete without inventing financial meaning.
acceptance_criteria: a versioned repo-owned Mapping Master holds selection records keyed by department, function and canonical plant that own the plant aliases and the MIS format, plus entry records mapping cost centre and GL code to an MIS line with a provisional flag and a reason, and a strict loader rejects a malformed master or a duplicate selection key so resolution is deterministic; the Excel workbooks are seed evidence recorded as a source provenance string and are never runtime input, so renaming a source file cannot change the output

the nine unresolved DUB composite-key triples map to the reserved unmapped-GL line flagged provisional with a reason, and a fixture proves every DUB raw plant cost-centre GL triple resolves exactly once with 66 mapped plus 22 bucketed equal to the full 88 rows and no fan-out
plant alias authority lives in the master so the canonical plant, the SAP alias and the display alias all resolve from it and no hard-coded alias table remains in ingestion

plan_contracts.statement: a versioned repo-owned Mapping Master holds selection records keyed by department, function and canonical plant that own the plant aliases and the MIS format, plus entry records mapping cost centre and GL code to an MIS line with a provisional flag and a reason, and a strict loader rejects a malformed master or a duplicate selection key so resolution is deterministic; the Excel workbooks are seed evidence recorded as a source provenance string and are never runtime input, so renaming a source file cannot change the output

required_tests.id: the mapping master loader accepts the versioned master and rejects a malformed master a duplicate selection key and a provisional entry that carries no reason, and the master is the single authority for the canonical plant the SAP alias and the display alias

the mapping master maps each of the nine unresolved DUB triples to the reserved unmapped GL line with a reason and its mapped plus bucketed triples are exactly the twenty eight distinct DUB triples so nothing is inferred and nothing is dropped

tasks.reviewer_focus: FIRST task of mis-selection (user_facing:false): build the versioned repo-owned Mapping Master that becomes the SINGLE runtime authority for selection and validation. NO resolution API, NO HTTP route, NO governed-builder change, NO UI (tasks 2 and 3). STANDARDS (load-bearing for a NEW backend module): constitution/03-modular-monolith-structure.md and constitution/pnp-coding-standards-modular-monolith.md govern module layout, boundaries and naming - the new backend/src/mapping module follows them; constitution/07-exception-handling.md governs the loader's failure mode (one clear typed error, never a silent fallback). The mapping-specific seams follow. THE ARTIFACT - a COMPILED TypeScript module, not a runtime-loaded JSON file (grill MAJOR: production runs node dist/main.js, so a ts-node-only JSON.parse under backend/src would pass every test and fail at app boot). Author the master as backend/src/mapping/mis-mapping-master.ts exporting a typed const - the ESTABLISHED runtime precedent is exactly this (backend/src/db/migrate.ts baseRolePerms, backend/src/semantic/semanticLayer.ts baseDomains). The frozen-JSON+loader shape stays where it belongs: TEST expectations. The strict validator runs over the typed const at module load. SHAPE (normalized, two record kinds, so resolution is deterministic): (a) SELECTION records keyed by (department, function, plant_canonical) OWNING the plant aliases, the mis_format, and the Budget GL coverage set; (b) ENTRY records under a selection mapping (cost_center, gl_code) -> mis_line with `provisional` and `reason`. A flat per-triple row is WRONG: repeating department/function/aliases/format per triple lets a conflicting alias or format make resolution non-deterministic with no principled winner. PINNED DATA (grill BLOCKER: the master must not be guesswork). The one selection is Department=Agriculture, Function=Nursery, plant_canonical=DUB, aliases = SAP `DUB-NUR` + display `Agri - Nursery - DUB`, mis_format = the pinned Financial-MIS (Table-2) identifier. HUMAN-decided (grill round): each resolved triple's `mis_line` is Sheet1's `Revised GL name` for that GL, copied VERBATIM and frozen - it is the only line-like label the source provides, so nothing is invented. Do NOT source lines from Nursery MIS Format.xlsx: its format sheet is Table-1 (Operational MIS), which docs/specs/financial-mis-statement.md puts OUT of scope (Table-2 only). The whole master is provisional (the spec calls for a provisional master); bucket entries additionally carry a `reason`. Freeze the exact triple->line mapping and assert it, so a fixture cannot satisfy the 28-triple count while assigning triples to wrong or identical lines. DETERMINISM (grill BLOCKER): the loader MUST reject - a malformed master; a DUPLICATE selection key (department+function+plant_canonical); a DUPLICATE (cost_center, gl_code) entry WITHIN one selection; an alias REUSED ACROSS selections (two canonical plants for one alias); and a provisional entry with no reason. Each of the last three would otherwise produce two matching entries or an ambiguous canonical plant, directly violating 'exactly once / no fan-out'. The module MUST EXPORT the canonical normalized-triple lookup (e.g. resolve a (plant, cost_center, gl_code) triple to its entry-or-bucket outcome); the D-0008 proof CALLS that export and must NOT reimplement resolution, or the proof is circular. BUDGET BUCKET (grill BLOCKER - the approved 'mirror the bucket for Budget' had no model): Budget has NO SAP plant and NO SAP cost centre - mis_budget's cost_center is an informational Budget-Components LABEL (decision 0016), so a (cost_center, gl_code) key CANNOT express a Budget rule. Model it here as a GL-ONLY Budget coverage set on the SELECTION record: the master declares the resolved Budget GL set, and a budget GL outside it resolves to the unmapped-GL bucket. Task 2 APPLIES this rule; the master stays the single authority. Cost centre is never part of the Budget key. SEED EVIDENCE (verified against the workbook - do NOT re-derive at runtime): SAP Entries Mapping.xlsx Sheet1 header is `Plant | Cost Center | GL code | Revised GL name | Cost Center` - TWO Cost Center columns, 94 rows where B != E, and only column E (Primary/secondary/Tertiary) matches what SAP actually books, so column E is AUTHORITATIVE. Every Sheet1 Plant is the literal `DUB`. In SAP Report the only DUB-family plant is `DUB-NUR` (88 rows, 28 distinct triples). GL alone is NOT unique - 50001605 appears three times under Primary/secondary/Tertiary - so the key is the TRIPLE. Carry a `source` provenance string naming the seed workbook (as july-dub-reconciliation.json does): the workbooks are SEED EVIDENCE, never runtime input. FILENAME INDEPENDENCE (grill MAJOR - C1 was not falsified): a required test must MUTATE the `source` provenance string and prove every triple still resolves to the same MIS line and the same bucket outcome, so nothing can consult the workbook name at runtime. THE UNMAPPED-GL BUCKET (decision 0018 - never infer, never drop): the NINE unresolved triples get EXPLICIT entries targeting the reserved unmapped-GL line, each provisional with a reason - GLs 50001701, 50001702, 50001703, 50001704, 50001705, 50001706 and 50001905 are ABSENT from Sheet1 (11 rows), and 50001902 + 50001903 are a CONFLICT (Sheet1 says Tertiary, SAP books Primary - 11 rows). 66 resolved + 22 bucketed = 88. Record the conflict pair AS A CONFLICT; do NOT silently pick one of the two Cost Center columns. ALIAS AUTHORITY (C3): backend/src/ingest/plant-mapping.ts:1-7 hard-codes PLANT_NORMALIZATION = {'DUB-NUR':'DUB'}; canonicalPlant() runs at INGEST (sap-actuals.parser.ts:142, import :4) writing canonical plant + raw plant_src. KEEP the canonicalPlant() export and its call site but DERIVE its table from the master so there is exactly one alias authority - that keeps warehouse-migrate.ts:59,72 and the three gated db tests (golden-financial.db.test.ts:350, gl-month-rollups.db.test.ts:86, composed-relation.db.test.ts:150) working unchanged. If July's DUB reconciliation total moves, the change is wrong. TESTS: the three required_tests are HERMETIC in backend/src/mapping/mapping-master.test.ts. Additionally a NEW gated backend/src/mapping/mapping-master.db.test.ts (`{ skip: process.env.WAREHOUSE_DB_TEST !== '1' }`, loopback-only TRUNCATE guard, migrateWarehouse()) is the D-0008 host proof against REALLY INGESTED data: ingest the real SAP workbook the way reconciliation.repository.test.ts does, then call the module's exported lookup and assert EVERY ingested DUB triple resolves EXACTLY ONCE - 66 mapped + 22 bucketed = 88 rows, none unresolved, none matching two entries. REGISTRATION: add the gated file to backend/package.json test:warehouse-proof (serialized --test-concurrency=1, RETAINING the four existing proofs) and the hermetic file to test:hermetic, plus the quality-gate hermeticTests registry (exactly one suite per file). Keep required_test ids regex-metacharacter-free and name each leaf VERBATIM (D-0024). Commit tests.json with the pinned host command + pass counts + a dead-port negative control BEFORE review (D-0008).

review_budget.reason: The story's foundation artifact: a versioned repo-owned Mapping Master with two normalized record kinds (selection records owning aliases + format, entry records mapping cost_center+gl to a mis_line with provisional/reason), a strict loader rejecting malformed masters, duplicate selection keys and reason-less provisional entries, the nine unmapped-GL bucket entries that keep the DUB slice complete (66 + 22 = 88), plant-alias authority folded out of the hard-coded ingest table into the master, and a gated D-0008 completeness proof against really-ingested data plus its registration. No resolution API, HTTP route, governed-builder change or UI.

tasks.title: Master-driven resolution, governed narrowing, and the first governed-query routes
tasks.objective: Resolve a selection through the master and narrow the single governed query path to it, exposed by the first governed-query HTTP routes so a client can never widen a report.
acceptance_criteria: resolving department, function, plant and period returns the applicable cost centres, GL set, MIS format and bucket rows, or an unresolvable outcome; the no mapping configured notice is decided by master resolution and never by whether the query returned rows, so a resolved selection with no transactions renders a configured zero result instead; the period options are the loaded actual months plus a derived FY 26-27 YTD that the server resolves from the latest active loaded month and never from the wall clock

the governed path is narrowed and never forked: the composed Actual side filters the resolved triples on actual_by_key_month and re-aggregates to gl code and month before the full outer join, the Budget side is restricted to the resolved GL set at its unchanged grain so no budget row outside the selection appears, the newly referenced warehouse object is listed in the objects touched so the validator still passes, and a demonstrated warehouse test proves a cost-centre-filtered selection yields one row per gl code and month with no fan-out and exact values

two authenticated routes expose it: an options route serving master-derived selector choices, and a run route that accepts only department, function, plant and period and never triples, GL codes, format ids or scope, both carrying named request and response types with documented error responses, registered in the application module and the route allow-list, and reusing the existing fail-closed governed authorization rather than bypassing it

required_tests.id: resolving a department function plant and period through the mapping master returns the cost centres the GL set the MIS format and the bucket rows, returns an unresolvable outcome for a selection the master does not cover so the no mapping configured notice never depends on whether the query returned rows, and derives the financial year to date period from the latest active loaded month rather than the wall clock

the composed builder narrows to a resolved selection by filtering the triples on actual by key month and re aggregating to gl code and month before the full outer join and by restricting the budget side to the resolved GL set at its unchanged grain, lists actual by key month among the objects touched so the validator still passes, and leaves an unselected composed query on its previous path

tasks.reviewer_focus: SECOND task of mis-selection (user_facing:false), the story's core: make a selection resolve through the mapping master and NARROW the single governed query path to it, exposed by the FIRST governed-query HTTP routes. NO UI (task 3). STANDARDS: constitution/03-modular-monolith-structure.md + pnp-coding-standards-modular-monolith.md (the new backend/src/mis module and the mapping module it consumes), constitution/pnp-api-standards.md + pnp-swagger-api-documentation-standards.md (these are FRESH routes, so named request/response DTOs and documented error responses are REQUIRED - the 0012 vendored-API deviation covers only the vendored controllers), constitution/07-exception-handling.md. BUILD ON TASK 1 (already merged, PR #25) - do NOT reimplement it: backend/src/mapping/mapping-master.ts exports MAPPING_MASTER, resolveMappingTriple(triple, master), canonicalPlantFromMaster(), UNMAPPED_GL_LINE and the MappingResolution/MappingSelection/MappingEntry types. Selection records carry department, function, plant_canonical, plant_aliases, mis_format and budget_gl_codes; entry records carry cost_center, gl_code, mis_line, provisional, reason. Resolution MUST go through those exports - the master stays the single authority. C1 RESOLUTION: resolve (department, function, plant, period) to the cost centres, the GL set, the mis_format and the bucket rows, or to an UNRESOLVABLE outcome. The 'no mapping configured' notice is decided by MASTER RESOLUTION ONLY and never by whether the query returned rows - a resolved selection with no transactions renders a configured ZERO result with NO notice; both cases need tests. The plant argument may arrive as any of the master's aliases (canonical DUB, SAP DUB-NUR, display 'Agri - Nursery - DUB') and resolves via the master, not a local table. PERIOD: options are the LOADED actual months only (query the active ingest batches - July 2026 today) PLUS one derived 'fy26-27-ytd'; the server resolves FY-YTD as 2026-04-01 through the LATEST ACTIVE LOADED MONTH - never Date.now()/the wall clock, or the answer changes with the calendar. C2 GOVERNED NARROWING (decision 0017 - filter BEFORE the roll-up, ONE path): in sqlBuilder composedCtes the Actual CTE becomes selection-aware - SELECT gl_code, month, SUM(actual_net)::numeric(18,2) FROM actual_by_key_month WHERE <existing scopePredicate> AND (plant, cost_center, gl_code) IN (<resolved triples>) GROUP BY gl_code, month. It ABSORBS the GROUP BY that actual_by_gl_month used to perform, so the reduction to one row per (gl_code, month) still happens BEFORE the FULL OUTER JOIN and the no-fan-out invariant that gl-month-rollups proved still holds. The BUDGET CTE is restricted to the resolved GL set at its UNCHANGED (gl_code, month) grain - this fixes a real defect the story plan grill found: budget_by_gl_month otherwise admits EVERY active DUB budget GL and the FULL OUTER JOIN would surface budget-only rows outside the selection, breaking 'exactly the DUB nursery slice'. Budget is NOT re-grained and cost centre is NEVER part of the Budget key (0016). 'actual_by_key_month' MUST be added to objectsTouched (sqlBuilder.ts:117-121) or sqlValidator.ts:43-49 rejects the query. An UNSELECTED composed query must keep its existing behaviour - the narrowing is additive. CARRIER: resolved triples CANNOT ride in selection.filters - sqlBuilder silently DROPS a filter whose dimensionId is not a declared dimension (sqlBuilder.ts:70), and there is no cost_center dimension by design. Pass them as a distinct resolved-scope input on the build path. UPDATE the pinned task-2/4 assertions this changes: sqlBuilder.composed.test.ts (its FROM actual_by_gl_month + objectsTouched regexes) and sqlValidator.composed.test.ts. Everything governed-joins established must still hold: the fail-closed executeResolved gate, two-sided scope, COALESCE zero-fill, the % CASE nil rule, and in-query provenance (source-presence, label set, (source,period,batchId) tuples). C3 THE FIRST GOVERNED-QUERY ROUTES: today app.module.ts:11-16 imports only Core/Health/Ingest and app.routes.test.ts:20-30 is a deepEqual ALLOW-LIST of 9 routes - Reports/Chat controllers exist but are NOT routed. Add a mis module + controller + service modelled on backend/src/reports/reports.controller.ts and reports.service.ts:69-92 (resolveAuthorizedSelection), register it in app.module.ts, and EXTEND the app.routes.test.ts allow-list with exactly the new routes (that test fails otherwise). Guard with AuthGuard + RequireAction('report') (auth.guard.ts:77-90) and @CurrentUser(); CSRF is already global. TWO routes: an OPTIONS route serving master-derived selector choices, and a RUN route that accepts ONLY {department, function, plant, period}. The run request must NEVER accept triples, GL codes, format ids or scope - a client able to supply resolved scope could WIDEN a report, which is the escalation seam the story grill closed by construction; a test must prove the DTO rejects such an attempt. The server resolves via the master, authorises, and invokes the EXISTING SelectionExecutor - do not bypass it. TESTS: the three required_tests are HERMETIC. Additionally a NEW gated backend/src/warehouse/selection-slice.db.test.ts ({ skip: process.env.WAREHOUSE_DB_TEST !== '1' }, loopback-only TRUNCATE guard, migrateWarehouse()) is the D-0008 host proof: seed multi-cost-centre actuals + budget via IngestionRepository, then prove a cost-centre-filtered selection returns ONE row per (gl_code, month) with NO fan-out and EXACT values, and that a budget GL outside the resolved set does NOT appear. Register it in backend/package.json test:warehouse-proof (serialized --test-concurrency=1, RETAINING the five existing proofs) and the hermetic files in test:hermetic, plus the quality-gate hermeticTests registry (exactly one suite per file). Keep required_test ids regex-metacharacter-free and name each leaf VERBATIM (D-0024). Commit tests.json with the pinned host command + pass counts + a dead-port negative control BEFORE review (D-0008). NOTE: SAP Entries Mapping.xlsx is DUAL-PURPOSE - its 'SAP Report' sheet holds the real 4,113 transaction lines; a review claiming it is mapping-only evidence is false (see the ledgered lesson).

review_budget.reason: The story's core task, three coupled deliverables. (1) Master-driven resolution of (department, function, plant, period) to a scope or an unresolvable outcome, with the notice decided by resolution rather than row count and FY-YTD derived from the latest loaded month. (2) The governed narrowing per decision 0017 - a selection-aware Actual CTE filtering resolved triples on actual_by_key_month and re-aggregating before the join, plus the Budget CTE restricted to the resolved GL set (fixing a real acceptance-criterion-1 defect) - which necessarily moves the pinned composed builder/validator assertions and adds a gated D-0008 no-fan-out slice proof. (3) The FIRST governed-query HTTP routes (options + run) with named DTOs and documented errors, a run request that cannot carry scope, and the app module + route allow-list registration. Larger than a normal task because the routes and the builder change are inseparable from the resolution they exist to serve.

tasks.title: Authenticated MIS Reports selection page
tasks.objective: Give a user the authenticated MIS Reports page that produces the DUB nursery slice, distinguishes both zero states, and makes the mapping gap visible.
acceptance_criteria: an authenticated MIS Reports page presents Department, Function, Plant and period as native select controls populated from the options route, offering only the loaded actual months plus FY 26-27 YTD, and Generate runs the selection through the run route so that selecting Agriculture, Nursery and DUB returns exactly the DUB nursery slice

the page shows a resolved-scope readout naming the cost centres, GL codes and MIS format the selection resolved to, and renders the two zero states distinctly: a no mapping configured notice with zeros for an unresolvable selection, and a configured zero result without that notice for a resolved selection that has no transactions

the unmapped-GL bucket is rendered as a reviewable list of its triples with amounts so the mapping gap is visible rather than absorbed, and the MIS Reports navigation item and page title are enabled in the application shell
